note: Base Events Log Track module: storage table event_log_track, report View at /admin/reports/events-track (perm 'access event log track'), settings form at /admin/config/system/events-log-track (route event_log_track.settings_form, config event_log_track.settings with enable_log_deletion/timespan_limit/batch_size/disable_db_logs/log_cli/skip_patterns). Logging via EventLogTrackManager::insert() (service event_log_track.manager); CLI events dropped unless log_cli. Extension via hook_event_log_track_handlers/_alter/_log_alternative; no plugin type. Medium cases insert a known sentinel row (ref_char ELT_MED_SENTINEL) into the event_log_track table and read it back. Hard cases are config builds on event_log_track.settings (log deletion + skip patterns), verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with events_log_track enabled, where do I view the logged events, where are the module's settings, and what database table stores the logs?
evals.expected_output: Logged events are shown as a View at /admin/reports/events-track (permission 'access event log track'). Settings are at /admin/config/system/events-log-track (route event_log_track.settings_form). Logs are stored in the custom event_log_track database table (columns type, operation, description, ref_numeric, ref_char, uid, ip, path, created).

evals.prompt: How do I make events_log_track automatically delete log entries older than a set number of days?
evals.expected_output: Turn on 'Enable log deletion' (config enable_log_deletion = true) and set 'Timespan Limit' (timespan_limit) to the number of days to keep. On cron, the module batch-deletes rows older than timespan_limit days (batch_size per chunk). Configure at /admin/config/system/events-log-track.

evals.prompt: From custom code, how do I record my own event in Events Log Track, and what fields does a log entry have? Also, why might a log written from a Drush command not appear?
evals.expected_output: Call \Drupal::service('event_log_track.manager')->insert($log) with at least type, operation and description (optional ref_numeric/ref_char; uid/ip/path/created are auto-filled). To register a new type for the report filters implement hook_event_log_track_handlers(). A log written under CLI/Drush is skipped unless the log_cli setting is TRUE.

evals.prompt: A single event has been logged in this site's Events Log Track table with the distinctive ref_char value 'ELT_MED_SENTINEL'. Inspect the event_log_track table and report the event 'type' recorded for that row.
evals.expected_output: The row with ref_char = 'ELT_MED_SENTINEL' has type = 'taxonomy' (query the event_log_track table, e.g. drush sqlq "SELECT type FROM event_log_track WHERE ref_char='ELT_MED_SENTINEL'").

evals.prompt: In this site's Events Log Track log, there is a row whose ref_char is 'ELT_MED_SENTINEL'. Inspect the live log and report the exact description text stored on that row.
evals.expected_output: The description of the row with ref_char = 'ELT_MED_SENTINEL' is 'SENTINEL_DESC_42' (from the event_log_track table).

evals.prompt: On this site, set up Events Log Track so it automatically removes any log entries older than 7 days. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In event_log_track.settings, enable_log_deletion = true and timespan_limit = 7 (via the settings form or drush config:set event_log_track.settings enable_log_deletion true / timespan_limit 7).

evals.prompt: Configure Events Log Track so that any event whose ref_char matches 'system.*' is not logged. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In event_log_track.settings, skip_patterns contains a line 'system.*' (drush config:set event_log_track.settings skip_patterns 'system.*'). The manager's shouldSkip() then drops any log whose ref_char matches that glob.
